camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore ModifyInstanceSpec --region cn-hangzhou --CouponNo youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank --MajorVersion '5.0' --BusinessInfo 000000001 --ForceTrans false --StorageType essd_pl1 --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --EffectiveTime Immediately --ReplicaCount 1 --ReadOnlyCount 5 --InstanceClass 'redis.master.small.default' --AutoPay true --SourceBiz SDK --ShardCount 8 --SlaveReplicaCount 1 --SlaveReadOnlyCount 2 --OrderType DOWNGRADE --Storage 60 --NodeType MASTER_SLAVE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --ForceUpgrade true
description_en: Changes the configurations of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 变更云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的规格
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore modify-instance-spec --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --instance-class redis.master.small.default --business-info 000000001 --coupon-no youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank --force-upgrade true --effective-time Immediately --auto-pay true --order-type DOWNGRADE --major-version 5.0 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --source-biz SDK --shard-count 8 --replica-count 1 --slave-replica-count 1 --read-only-count 5 --slave-read-only-count 2 --force-trans false --node-type MASTER_SLAVE --storage-type essd_pl1 --storage 60 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceSpec

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html查询，使用此参数指定要变更实例的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The new instance type. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473765.html operation to query the instance types available for configuration change within the zone to which the instance belongs.

>  For more information about the instance types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html
parameters.help_zh:
变更后的实例规格代码，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473765.html查询实例所属的可用区可以变配的规格。

> 各规格的详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en: The ID of the promotional event or the business information
parameters.help_zh: 活动ID、业务信息
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. Default value: `youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank`
parameters.help_zh: 优惠码，默认值：`youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank`
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly change the configurations. Valid values:

*   **false**: The system does not forcefully change the configurations.
*   **true** (default): The system forcefully changes the configurations
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制变配，取值：
* **false**：不强制变配。
* **true**：强制变配，默认值
parameters.name: force_upgrade

parameters.help_en:
The time when you want the configurations to be changed. Valid values:

*   **Immediately** (default): immediately changes the configurations.
*   **MaintainTime**: changes the configurations within the maintenance window. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html operation to change the maintenance window
parameters.help_zh:
变更执行时间，取值：
* **Immediately**：立即执行，默认值。
* **MaintainTime**：在实例的可维护时间段执行，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html修改可维护时间段
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

*   **true** (default): enables automatic payment.
*   **false**: disables automatic payment. If you set this parameter to **false**, the instance must be manually renewed before it expires. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26352.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付款，取值：
* **true**：自动付款，默认值。
* **false**：手动付款。取值为**false**时，您需要在实例到期前通过控制台手动续费，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26352.html
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The change type. This parameter is required when you change the configurations of a subscription instance. Valid values:

*   **UPGRADE** (default): upgrades the configurations of the subscription instance.
*   **DOWNGRADE**: downgrades the configurations of the subscription instance.

> 

*   To downgrade a subscription instance, you must set this parameter to **DOWNGRADE**.

*   If the price of an instance increases after its configurations are changed, the instance is upgraded. If the price decreases, the instance is downgraded. For example, the price of an 8 GB read/write splitting instance with five read replicas is higher than that of a 16 GB cluster instance. If you want to change a 16 GB cluster instance to an 8 GB read/write splitting instance with five read replicas, you must upgrade the instance
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型，包年包月实例变配时需要传入本参数，取值：

* **UPGRADE**：升级配置，默认值。
* **DOWNGRADE**：降级配置。

> * 包年包月实例降级配置时必须将该参数的值设置为**DOWNGRADE**。
> *  如果变配的目标规格比现有规格的价格高，则为升级配置，反之为降级配置。例如，读写分离8G版（5只读节点）的价格比16G集群版的价格高，从后者变配到前者为升级配置
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The major version of the classic instance that you want to upgrade. Valid values: **2.8**, **4.0**, and **5.0**.

>  The **InstanceClass** parameter is required when you upgrade the instance version. This parameter indicates that you can upgrade the instance version only when you update the instance specifications. If you only need to upgrade the instance version, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473776.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
适用于经典版实例升级的实例大版本，取值：**2.8**、**4.0**或**5.0**。
> 升级版本时**InstanceClass**参数为必填，表示本接口仅支持在更新实例规格时升级版本。若您仅需升级实例版本，请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473776.html
parameters.name: major_version

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The source of the operation. This parameter is used only for internal maintenance. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 调用来源，本参数仅用于内部维护使用，无需传入
parameters.name: source_biz

parameters.help_en:
The number of shards. This parameter is applicable only to cloud-native cluster instances.

> 

*   If you want to change a cloud-native cluster instance to a standard instance, you must explicitly set the ShardCount parameter to 1 and specify the specifications of the master-replica instance.

*   To change a cloud-native standard instance to a cluster instance, you must explicitly set the ShardCount parameter to a value greater than 1 and specify the specifications of the cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
分片数，本参数仅适用于云原生版集群架构实例，您可以通过该参数实现自定义分片数量。

> 
> - 如果要从云原生版集群架构实例变配到标准架构 ，ShardCount 需要显式传 1，并且规格传标准规格。
> - 如果要从云原生版标准架构实例变配到集群架构，ShardCount 需要显式传大于1的值，并且规格传集群规格
parameters.name: shard_count

parameters.help_en:
The number of replica nodes in the primary zone. This parameter is applicable only to cloud-native multi-replica cluster instances. Valid values: 1 to 4.

> 

*   The sum of the values of this parameter and the SlaveReplicaCount parameter cannot be greater than 4.

*   You can specify either ReplicaCount or ReadOnlyCount.

*   A master-replica instance cannot contain multiple replica nodes
parameters.help_zh:
主可用区的备节点数量，本参数仅适用于云原生版集群多副本实例，您可以通过该参数实现自定义备节点数量，取值：1~4。

> 若实例为多可用区实例，您可以通过该参数与SlaveReplicaCount参数自定义主、备可用区的备节点数量。同时，该参数与SlaveReplicaCount参数的总和不能超过4
parameters.name: replica_count

parameters.help_en:
The number of replica nodes in the secondary zone when you create a cloud-native multi-replica cluster instance that is deployed across multiple zones. The sum of the values of this parameter and the ReplicaCount parameter cannot be greater than 4.

>  When you create a cloud-native multi-replica cluster instance that is deployed across multiple zones, you must specify both SlaveReplicaCount and SecondaryZoneId
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区的备节点数量
parameters.name: slave_replica_count

parameters.help_en:
The number of read replicas in the primary zone. Valid values: 0 to 5. This parameter applies only to the following scenarios:

*   If the instance is a cloud-native standard instance, you can set this parameter to a value greater than 0 to enable the read/write splitting architecture.
*   If the instance is a cloud-native read/write splitting instance, you can use this parameter to customize the number of read replicas. You can also set this parameter to 0 to disable the read/write splitting architecture and switch the instance to the standard architecture
parameters.help_zh:
主可用区的只读节点数，本参数仅适用于创建云原生读写分离实例。
* 若实例为标准架构，取值为0-9，0表示关闭读写分离，将实例切换为标准架构。
* 若实例为集群架构，取值为1-4，表示每数据分片的只读节点数。
> 若创建多可用区实例，您可以通过该参数和SlaveReadOnlyCount参数自定义主备可用区的只读节点数量。
> * 若实例为标准架构，该参数与SlaveReadOnlyCount的总和不能大于9。
> * 若实例为集群架构，该参数与SlaveReadOnlyCount的总和不能大于4
parameters.name: read_only_count

parameters.help_en: The number of read replicas in the secondary zone when you create a read/write splitting instance that is deployed across multiple zones. Valid values: 1 to 9. The sum of the values of this parameter and the ReadOnlyCount parameter cannot be greater than 9
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区的只读节点数量
parameters.name: slave_read_only_count

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable forced transmission during a configuration change. Valid values:

*   **false** (default): Before the configuration change, the system checks the minor version of the instance. If the minor version of the instance is outdated, an error is reported. You must update the minor version of the instance and try again.
*   **true**: The system skips the version check and directly performs the configuration change
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启强制传输，取值：
- **false**（默认）：在变配前，系统会检查实例当前的内核小版本，若内核版本过低则会报错，您需要升级内核小版本后重试。
- **true**：跳过检查项，直接执行变配操作
parameters.name: force_trans

parameters.help_en:
The type of the node. Valid values:

*   **MASTER_SLAVE**: high availability (master-replica)
*   **STAND_ALONE**: standalone
*   **double**: master-replica
*   **single**: standalone

>  To create a cloud-native instance, set this parameter to **MASTER_SLAVE** or **STAND_ALONE**. To create a classic instance, set this parameter to **double** or **single**
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型，取值：
* **MASTER_SLAVE**：高可用（双副本）
* **STAND_ALONE**：单副本
* **double**：双副本
* **single**：单副本
> 云原生版实例请选择**MASTER_SLAVE**或**STAND_ALONE**，经典版实例请选择**double**或**single**
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values: **essd_pl1**, **essd_pl2**, and **essd_pl3**.

>  This parameter is required only when you set the **InstanceType** parameter to **tair_essd** to create an ESSD-based instance
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型，取值为**essd_pl1**、**essd_pl2**、**essd_pl3**。
> 当**InstanceType**取值为**tair_essd**时，且实例为Tair磁盘**ESSD**型时，才需要输入本参数
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The storage capacity of the ESSD/SSD-based instance. The valid values vary based on the instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527111.html.

>  This parameter is required only when you set the **InstanceType** parameter to **tair_essd** to create an ESSD-based instance. If you create a Tair **SSD**-based instance, the Storage parameter is automatically specified based on predefined specifications. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘型实例的存储空间，不同的规格取值范围有所区别，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527111.html。
> 当**InstanceType**取值为**tair_essd**时，且创建Tair磁盘**ESSD**型时，才需要输入本参数。对于创建 Tair磁盘**SSD**型实例，容量字段按不同的规格定义为不同的固定值，无需指定该字段
parameters.name: storage
